title: Data Types and Constraints
description: Master SQL Server data types, NULL handling, and constraints. Learn how to enforce data integrity at the database level.
whatYouLearn: The main families of SQL Server data types: numeric, string, date/time, and binary
How SQL Server stores and represents NULL values using three-valued logic
How constraints (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK) protect data quality
How to choose the right data type for each column to save space and improve performance
How to add, modify, and remove constraints from existing tables
